name: Chorale
description: The cabinet turning slowly: the horn at 0.8 Hz and the drum a little slower, the microphones apart.

name: Guitar Swirl
description: Slow, mixed with the dry signal and close-miked for a guitar or an electric piano.

name: Mono Close
description: One microphone close to the cabinet: the swirl as level and pitch, with no stereo.

name: Overdriven Cabinet
description: The amplifier driven hard and the horn up a little, fast: the cabinet a rock organist leans on.

name: Stopped
description: The rotors held still: the cabinet's colour and its walls, and no swirl until the speed is switched.

name: Tremolo
description: The cabinet at speed: the horn near 7 Hz and the drum close behind.

name: Wide Chorale
description: The cabinet turning slowly with the drum on one close microphone, and the microphones set wide: the drum still heard in stereo beside the horn.
